Raw copies preserve source bytes. Per-file hashes refer to exact bytes, including line endings.
Local inventory covers attempt inputs, task outputs, IPC, receipts and selected Run metadata; duplicate Artifact-store copies are not repeated.
Runtime binaries, GBW and other binary intermediates are retained locally and not committed; private runtime manifests are referenced by hash.
